title: services.packages.adjust_grant params
description: Adjusts a SOLD voucher: more sessions and/or a later expiry as a courtesy (services#118) — «one more session on the house», «extended a month because we were closed» — or fewer sessions as a balance correction (services#119) — «a session was spent twice by mistake». It is written as a movement with who, when and why; the purchase itself is never rewritten. Sessions only on a voucher with a session limit (never more taken away than are left), days only on one that expires and only later. It moves NO money and issues no fiscal document.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant (the voucher purchase) being adjusted.

uses_delta.description: Sessions added to (positive) or taken from (negative) what the customer has left; never more taken than are left.

reason.description: Why, in the operator's words. Mandatory: it stays in the voucher's movements.
